Eb.bar_b_note: Clean, well-blocked blue-and-coral design carries it, but the long low body barely clears the trainer and side A's faint poses read as standing/sitting rather than fainted.

Vr.bar_b_note: Readable spotted-deer silhouette at good scale, but the flat material and small plain antlers sit below Palworld finish, and side A's faint end sinks into the floor.

Ec.bar_b_note: Same appealing deer, but the flat material and, on side B, sideways-splayed faint legs and a static hit react keep it short of shipping polish.

Ti.bar_b_note: One dark mid-tone with no storm sky or lightning, flat magenta decal telegraphs, a heavy HUD and (on B) camera-in-foliage frames.

Xn.bar_b_note: Side A's snake levitates in its faint poses and side B's marbled surface muddies the silhouette.

To.bar_b_note: Good colour blocking and readable faints, held back by marginal height against the trainer and a clean but not rim-lit material.

Vb.bar_b_note: Smeared ground textures, empty flat terrain and a washed sky sink it, though B's toppled banners and smoke give each aftermath a site-specific read.

Fd.bar_b_note: An expressive stylised face and a warm natural costume palette sit comfortably beside Palworld's characters.

top_changes.change: Stormwood fight: real-object telegraphs, camera clear of canopy, purple storm sky and lightning
Meadows sites: crisp grass, groves and depth; every after frame removes or topples the oxblood banner
Creature turntables: distinct grounded hit and faint poses; raise the lizard above the trainer
